# SoFarAway

> A hypnotic browser rhythm runner. Thread the gates, ride the beat.

SoFarAway is an English-language game by LibreCosta. WebGL2 renders four procedural worlds and Web Audio synthesizes their soundtracks in the browser.

## Play and explore

- [Play SoFarAway](https://sofaraway.librecosta.com/): Fly ELSEWHERE, DAYBREAK, DESCENT and ORBIT in Standard, Sightseeing or Showcase mode.
- [Technical Explorer](https://sofaraway.librecosta.com/debug/): Inspect the production worlds, gates, lighting, materials, gameplay, endings, music and interface.

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/librecosta/sofaraway): Source code, controls, build instructions and project history.
